title: Why it sucks being a Club Brugge fan

scenes.text: Why it sucks being a... Club Brugge fan!
It starts when you're six. Your club is called... Club. Your friends ask: "Club what?" "Just Club."
Age eight. You share your stadium with your rivals. Cercle. Same stadium. Same seats. Very different moods.
Age nine. The club promises a new stadium. "Next year!" It's still next year.
Age twelve. You win the league! Again! Now everyone in Belgium hates you.
Age fourteen. Your dad tells you about two European finals. Both against Liverpool. Both lost. He still can't watch the Premier League.
Age seventeen. Champions League! You knock out a giant! Next round... Aston Villa. Back to Belgium.
That's the thing about being a Club Brugge fan. You win so much... nobody feels sorry for you.
But you don't need their pity. You've got trophies. And one day... a new stadium. Probably.
Tag a Club Brugge fan. Not a Cercle fan. And which club is next? Drop it in the comments!
